note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `meta` is a key-bag whose shape changes between rounds: the datasets-server infers `meta` from `batch-r01.jsonl`, where both records carry only `{factory, generator, round}`, then cannot cast the later records that add `kind`, `seed`, `designed`, `domain`, `stack`, `lane`, `product` and `mechanic`. Declaring the union fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: plan
features.note: present on all 304 records; mandatory here, unlike the optional `plan` of `long-horizon-coding-trajectories`

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool — `command`, `path`, `old`, `new`, `contents`, `pattern`, `target`, `url`, `args`, `cmd` across `bash`, `read`, `edit`, `write`, `grep`, `pytest` and `fetch`

list.name: reflection
list.note: present on 4870 of 5015 steps, absent on 145 steps spread over 10 records in rounds 1, 6, 7, 8 and 14

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success`, `tests_passed` and `cost_steps` on all 304 records, plus `plan_changes` on 294, `retries` / `duration_min` / `wasted_calls` on 294, `handoff` on 2 and `xfailed` on 1

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `generator` and `round` on all 304 records, plus `kind` on 296, `seed` / `designed` / `domain` / `stack` on 294, `lane` on 8 (rounds 2-5 only) and `product` / `mechanic` on 2 (round 64 only)

disclosures.summary: Two dest-stamped rows in `batch-r64.jsonl` keep `meta.factory` = `csv-excel-ingest-factory` but are Buildx Bake HCL cache leftover payloads (`meta.kind` = `designed`, with `product` / `mechanic` in place of `seed` / `designed` / `domain` / `stack`). They are kept exactly as generated and belong to the already-frozen leftover-mill class; no new census is opened for them.

Eight records carry a thin `meta` of only `{factory, generator, round}`. Two of them sit in `batch-r01.jsonl`, so they are what the datasets-server infers the whole column from before failing to cast every later record.

disclosures: A separate group of eight records, in rounds 2 through 5, carries a ninth `meta` key `lane` (always the string `b`) that no other record has, and omits `reward.plan_changes`. It does not overlap the eight thin-`meta` records at all.

The 294 records that are neither the two `dbc-*` rows nor the eight thin-`meta` rows all carry `meta.kind` = `episode` and are `csv-excel-ingest-factory` episodes generated by `grok-4.6`. 15 of them name `leftover` in the record id and 79 carry the `leftover leftover leftover` mill wording inside `meta.stack`; both are this factory's own advertised leftover-sidecar vs naive-unlink mechanic, not a foreign dump, so the dataset is not a factory mix.
Every one of the 5015 steps publishes a public `decision_basis`. There are no hidden `thought`, `chain_of_thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields anywhere in the payload.
